$comment: Discovery tuning. The crawler runs on a small unauthenticated API budget by default, so it must be frugal: search results already carry full repository metadata, which lets us pre-filter candidates BEFORE spending a 'core' API call on them.

prefilter.$comment: Applied to provisional metadata before any core API call. Deliberately looser than the real gates in thresholds.json — this only removes obvious noise.

rising.$comment: Dark-horse detection. Sorting every query by total stars hides new fast risers forever, so we additionally ask GitHub for recently-created repos with meaningful traction. This is what lets a newcomer overtake an incumbent.
